notes: This manifest is the canonical list of automated suites for Forseti.
Keep commands local/dev by default; production runs must remain explicitly gated (e.g., ALLOW_PROD_QA=1 where applicable).

suites.label: Jobhunter E2E flow (Playwright)
suites.command: bash -c 'set -e; DRUSH=/var/www/html/forseti/vendor/bin/drush; $DRUSH --uri=http://localhost jhtr:qa-users-ensure --roles=authenticated 2>/dev/null; QA_UID=$($DRUSH --uri=http://localhost user:information qa_tester_authenticated --format=json 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(list(d.keys())[0])"); ULI=$($DRUSH --uri=http://localhost user:login --uid=$QA_UID --no-browser 2>/dev/null | tr -d "\n"); cd /home/ubuntu/forseti.life && ULI_URL=$ULI BASE_URL=http://localhost ARTIFACTS_DIR=sessions/qa-forseti/artifacts/jobhunter-e2e-latest node testing/jobhunter-workflow-step1-6-data-engineer.mjs'
run_notes: Requires: Drupal site running at http://localhost, drush jhtr:qa-users-ensure available, Playwright chromium installed.
The command auto-provisions qa_tester_authenticated user, acquires a ULI via drush, then runs the Playwright E2E flow.
Dual-user isolation tests (TC-11/TC-16) are flagged for manual execution or future jhtr:qa-users-ensure multi-user support.
Exit codes: 0=pass, 2=submission.success=false, 3=no matching job found in Philadelphia.

suites.label: Application-submission routes: auth=200, anon=403 (TC-04, TC-05)
